description.text:
Overgrow (茂) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Primordial Arts (洪荒演武), the third Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 17 November 2023 alongside Torrent (激), a V starter deck, two deck building gift boxes and a family set. It brought the battle styles to the game: Overgrow holds the new Single Strike (一击) cards and Torrent the Rapid Strike (连击) cards, each marked in its top right corner. Character Rare (CHR) cards, full-art cards of a Pokémon with its trainer first seen in the Sun & Moon series, came back, and a new rarity, Character Super Rare (CSR), showed Pokémon V with their trainers in a more elaborate finish. Packs still held 5 or 25 cards, but from this release a box held six 25-card packs instead of 24, and 5-card packs were no longer sold by the box. With it, the Standard format dropped the cards with the A and B regulation marks.

Overgrow has Venusaur VMAX on its cover. Its Single Strike cards include Single Strike Urshifu V and VMAX, Single Strike Energy, Houndoom and the Supporter Single Strike Style Mustard, and it also has Shadow Rider Calyrex V and VMAX, Galarian Zapdos V and Blissey V. Its main cards are numbered out of 125; Character Rare, full-art, Character Super Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 184.
